item.title: Students at Senn High School stage schoolwide anti-ICE walkout
item.description: <p>Dozens of students at Nicholas Senn High School in Chicago's Edgewater neighborhood walked out of school during sixth period Friday in protest of immigration policy and ICE tactics across the country. </p><p>Students gathered at the intersection of Clark Street and Ridge Avenue after 1 p.m. holding signs and flags calling for an end to immigration enforcement activity. item.title: Woman sentenced to prison for vandalizing Palestinian mural in Pilsen and 2 assaults
item.description: <p>A woman was sentenced to one year in prison after pleading guilty to hate crime charges connected to vandalizing a Palestinian mural last year in Pilsen.</p><p>Danielle Wasserman, 37, pleaded guilty to two counts of hate crime and was sentenced Friday to one year in prison, with credit for already serving 179 days in jail, according to court records. item.title: Man, 53, dies after Chatham shooting inside home
item.description: <p>A man was shot multiple times and was killed Friday night, Chicago police said.</p><p>The 53-year-old man was inside a home in the 8000 block of South Eberhart Avenue in Chatham about 5:40 p.m. when he was shot multiple times. </p><p>He was taken to University of Chicago Medical Center in critical condition, police said. He was later pronounced dead.</p><p>Area 2 detectives are investigating.</p>

item.title: Rapidly improving Ryan Lipke helps lead Joliet West past Plainfield East
item.description: <p>One of the most enjoyable aspects of high school sports is watching a player improve significantly over the course of a year, or even a few months.
